history.text: Hominin remains and footprints were left at Olduvai and Laetoli.
Kilwa Kisiwani grew rich on the Indian Ocean gold trade.
German East Africa was established, passing to Britain after the First World War.
Union with Zanzibar created Tanzania on 26 April.
